inform.para: PRO-NOR-SUP-LG_DN FLIGHT WITH GEAR DOWN and determine the associated Flight Manual performance penalties with the OCTOPUS program.

noteproc.para: In the Airbus EFB PERF takeoff and landing applications, this corresponds to the MEL item "LANDING GEAR POSITION EXTENDED". In the EFB PERF in-flight application, this corresponds to the NON STD CONF “L/G DISPATCH WITH GEAR DOWN”.
